title: tex-review pass file
description: One agent pass: a set of suggested edits to a manuscript, anchored on exact text. Either an object with a `suggestions` array, or a bare array of suggestions.

base_dir.description: Directory that suggestion `file` paths are relative to, itself relative to this pass file. Defaults to '..' (the pass file lives in <manuscript>/review/).

file.description: Path of the file to edit, relative to base_dir.

old.description: Exact text to replace, copied verbatim from the file (whitespace included). Must be unique in the file unless `occurrence` is set.

new.description: Replacement text; empty string deletes the anchored text.

occurrence.description: 1-based index selecting which occurrence of `old` to replace when it appears more than once.

reasoning.description: One-sentence explanation shown to the reviewer; may contain TeX math.

tags.description: Short labels such as grammar, clarity, typo, notation.

id.description: Short id unique within the pass file, e.g. s001.
